|translation='''Title:''' I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee.

'''Card text:'''
Play immediately after the opponent deploys a card. Spend 3 Force to return that card to the opponent's hand. Force spent to deploy that card remains spent. On the opponent's next turn, that card must be deployed to the same location unless that is impossible. Force is not spent for that deploy.

'''Lore:'''
Well, enjoy it as much as you can. You passionate one.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Timing is 配備した直後.
